result.topic_en: Calculations evaluating an Euler-type integral of the form ∫ z^a(1-z)^b(y-z)^c dz as a hypergeometric series F(α,β,γ,y) with Π (Gamma) factors, followed by transformations under substitutions y = 1 + tt/(1-1/x), and scattered side calculations on parameter relations and trigonometric identities.
result.transcription:
$\int_0^y z^{\beta-\frac{\gamma}{2}-\frac12}(1-z)^{\alpha-\frac{\gamma}{2}-\frac12}(y-z)^{\frac{\gamma}{2}-\alpha}\partial z$
$= y^{\beta-\alpha+\frac12}\int_0^1 z^{\beta-\frac{\gamma}{2}-\frac12}(1-z)^{\frac{\gamma}{2}-\alpha}(1-yz)^{\alpha-\frac{\gamma}{2}-\frac12}\partial z$
$= y^{\beta-\alpha+\frac12}\sum \Pi(\alpha-\frac{\gamma}{2}-\frac12)\,[-\Pi(\frac{\gamma}{2}-\alpha)-]\frac{\Pi(n+\beta-\frac{\gamma}{2}-\frac12)}{\Pi n\,\Pi(\alpha-\frac{\gamma}{2}-\frac12-n)\,\Pi(n+\beta-\alpha+\frac12)}y^n = \sum\frac{\Pi(n+\beta-\frac{\gamma}{2}-\frac12)\,\Pi(n-\alpha+\frac{\gamma}{2}-\frac12)}{\Pi n\,\Pi(n+\beta-\alpha+\frac12)}y^n\cdot\Pi(\frac{\gamma}{2}-\alpha)$
$= y^{\beta-\alpha+\frac12}\frac{\Pi(\beta-\frac{\gamma}{2}-\frac12)\,\Pi(\frac{\gamma}{2}-\alpha)}{\Pi(\beta-\alpha+\frac12)}\cdot F(\beta-\frac{\gamma}{2}+\frac12,\,-\alpha+\frac{\gamma}{2}+\frac12,\,\beta-\alpha+\frac32,\,y)$
$y = 1+\frac{tt}{1-\frac1x}$ $\qquad y=\frac{s}{(1-(1-x)s)x}$ [?]
$1-s+\frac1x s$ $\qquad (-(1-\frac1x))^{-\beta-1}x^{\beta+1}\int_0^1 s^{\alpha-1}(1-s)^{\gamma-\alpha}(1-xs)^{-\beta-1}\partial s = \frac{\Pi(\alpha-1)\,\Pi(\gamma-\alpha)}{\Pi\gamma}\cdot F(\alpha,\beta+1,\gamma+1,x)$
$\frac{1-s}{s}=-y$
$\frac{\Pi-\beta-1\,(-1)^n}{\Pi n\,\Pi-n-\beta-1}=\frac{\Pi(n+\beta)}{\Pi n\,\Pi\beta}$
$v\,[-\log(\frac{1}{tt}+\frac{x}{x-1})-]+2\pi i\log(\frac{1}{tt}+\frac{x}{1-x}) = 2\pi i\cdot\frac{2}{\sqrt\pi}\cdot\frac{1}{\Pi(\beta-\alpha+\frac12)}\cdot\frac1x\cdot(\frac1x-1)^{-\frac{\gamma}{2}-1}(1-x)^{+\beta+1}F(\alpha,\beta+1,\gamma+1,x)$
$(1+\frac{tt}{1-\frac1x})^{\beta-\alpha+\frac12}F(\beta-\frac{\gamma}{2}+\frac12,\,-\alpha+\frac{\gamma}{2}+\frac12,\,\beta-\alpha+\frac32,\,1+\frac{tt}{1-\frac1x})$
